description.value: Fuggles Beer Co. is Richmond's only brewery, producing award-winning craft beers served fresh in their tasting room. The venue features both indoor and outdoor reservable space, a hot food menu, and a dog-friendly patio — a natural gathering point for cyclists exploring the Richmond dyke trail network. Takeout is also available via DoorDash.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Fuggles Beer Co. is an active pub and microbrewery in Richmond with a food menu and DoorDash takeout ordering. Phone, address, and email all match between OSM tags and the /contact-us subpage. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi on the website; OSM wlan=free tag cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration per rules.
concerns: OSM combined address field omits unit number; website /contact-us confirms the full address as '11220 Horseshoe Way #103, Richmond, BC V7A 4V5' — used website value.
OSM wlan=free tag not corroborated by website content; Wi-Fi marked null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Fuggles is a legitimate, active pub and microbrewery well-positioned near Richmond's cycling routes, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A quick on-the-ground or phone verification of bike parking and washroom availability would likely resolve this to 'include'.
enrichment_extras.notes: Located near the Richmond dyke trail system; dog-friendly patio noted on website front page ('Dogs Welcome on patio').
